verses.en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;
verses.fr: Paul, apôtre de Jésus-Christ, par ordre de Dieu notre Sauveur et de Jésus-Christ notre espérance,
verses.am: መድኃኒታችን እግዚአብሔር ተስፋችንም ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እንዳዘዘው ትእዛዝ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሐዋርያ የሆነ ጳውሎስ፥

verses.en: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.fr: Timothée, mon enfant légitime en la foi: que la grâce, la miséricorde et la paix, te soient données de la part de Dieu le Père et de Jésus-Christ notre Seigneur!
verses.am: በእምነት እውነተኛ ልጄ ለሆነ ለጢሞቴዎስ፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ከአባታችን ከክርስቶስ ኢየሱስም ከጌታችን ጸጋና ምሕረት ሰላምም ይሁን።

verses.en: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,
verses.fr: Je te rappelle l''exhortation que je te fis, à mon départ pour la Macédoine, lorsque je t''engageai à rester à Ephèse, afin de recommander à certaines personnes de ne pas enseigner d''autres doctrines,

verses.en: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.
verses.fr: et de ne pas s''attacher à des fables et à des généalogies sans fin, qui produisent des discussions plutôt qu''elles n''avancent l''oeuvre de Dieu dans la foi.
verses.am: ወደ መቄዶንያ በሄድሁ ጊዜ፥ አንዳንዶች ልዩ ትምህርትን እንዳያስተምሩና ወደ ተረት መጨረሻም ወደሌለው ወደ ትውልዶች ታሪክ እንዳያደምጡ ልታዛቸው በኤፌሶን ትቀመጥ ዘንድ ለመንሁህ፤ እንደ እነዚህ ያሉ ነገሮች ክርክርን ያመጣሉና በእምነት ግን ላለ ለእግዚአብሔር መጋቢነት አይጠቅሙም።

verses.en: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:
verses.fr: Le but du commandement, c''est une charité venant d''un coeur pur, d''une bonne conscience, et d''une foi sincère.
verses.am: የትእዛዝ ፍጻሜ ግን ከንጹሕ ልብና ከበጎ ሕሊና ግብዝነትም ከሌለበት እምነት የሚወጣ ፍቅር ነው፤

verses.en: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;
verses.fr: Quelques-uns, s''étant détournés de ces choses, se sont égarés dans de vains discours;

verses.en: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.
verses.fr: ils veulent être docteurs de la loi, et ils ne comprennent ni ce qu''ils disent, ni ce qu''ils affirment.
verses.am: ከእነዚህም አንዳንዶች ስተው፥ የሚሉትን ወይም ስለ እነርሱ አስረግጠው የሚናገሩትን ሳያስተውሉ፥ የሕግ አስተማሪዎች ሊሆኑ እየወደዱ፥ ወደ ከንቱ ንግግር ፈቀቅ ብለዋል።

verses.en: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;
verses.fr: Nous n''ignorons pas que la loi est bonne, pourvu qu''on en fasse un usage légitime,
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሰው እንደሚገባ ቢሰራበት ሕግ መልካም እንደ ሆነ እናውቃለን፤

verses.en: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
verses.fr: sachant bien que la loi n''est pas faite pour le juste, mais pour les méchants et les rebelles, les impies et les pécheurs, les irréligieux et les profanes, les parricides, les meurtriers,

verses.en: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;
verses.fr: les impudiques, les infâmes, les voleurs d''hommes, les menteurs, les parjures, et tout ce qui est contraire à la saine doctrine, -
verses.am: ይኸውም፥ ለበደለኞችና ለማይታዘዙ፥ ለዓመጸኞችና ለኃጢአተኞች፥ ቅድስና ለሌላቸውና ለርኵሳን፥ አባትና እናትን ለሚገድሉ፥ ለነፍሰ ገዳዮችና ለሴሰኞች፥ ከወንድ ጋርም ለሚተኙ፥ በሰዎችም ለሚነግዱ፥ ለውሸተኞችም በውሸትም ለሚምሉ፥ የብሩክ እግዚአብሔርንም ክብር እንደሚገልጥ ለእኔ አደራ እንደ ተሰጠኝ ወንጌል የሆነውን ደኅና ትምህርት ለሚቃወም ለሌላ ነገር ሁሉ ሕግ እንደ ተሰራ እንጂ ለጻድቅ እንዳልተሰራ ሲያውቅ ነው።

verses.en: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
verses.fr: conformément à l''Evangile de la gloire du Dieu bienheureux, Evangile qui m''a été confié.
verses.am: ይኸውም፥ ለበደለኞችና ለማይታዘዙ፥ ለዓመጸኞችና ለኃጢአተኞች፥ ቅድስና ለሌላቸውና ለርኵሳን፥ አባትና እናትን ለሚገድሉ፥ ለነፍሰ ገዳዮችና ለሴሰኞች፥ ከወንድ ጋርም ለሚተኙ፥ በሰዎችም ለሚነግዱ፥ ለውሸተኞችም በውሸትም ለሚምሉ፥ የብሩክ እግዚአብሔርንም ክብር እንደሚገልጥ ለእኔ አደራ እንደ ተሰጠኝ ወንጌል የሆነውን ደኅና ትምህርት ለሚቃወም ለሌላ ነገር ሁሉ ሕግ እንደ ተሰራ እንጂ ለጻድቅ እንዳልተሰራ ሲያውቅ ነው።

verses.en: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;
verses.fr: Je rends grâces à celui qui m''a fortifié, à Jésus-Christ notre Seigneur, de ce qu''il m''a jugé fidèle, en m''établissant dans le ministère,
verses.am: ለአገልግሎቱ ሾሞኝ ታማኝ አድርጎ ስለ ቈጠረኝ፥ ኃይል የሰጠኝን ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስን ጌታችንን አመሰግናለሁ፤

verses.en: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
verses.fr: moi qui étais auparavant un blasphémateur, un persécuteur, un homme violent. Mais j''ai obtenu miséricorde, parce que j''agissais par ignorance, dans l''incrédulité;
verses.am: አስቀድሞ ተሳዳቢና አሳዳጅ አንገላችም ምንም ብሆን፥ ይህን አደረገልኝ፤ ነገር ግን ሳላውቅ ባለማመን ስላደረግሁት ምህረትን አገኘሁ፥

verses.en: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.fr: et la grâce de notre Seigneur a surabondé, avec la foi et la charité qui est en Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: የጌታችንም ጸጋ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ካሉ ከእምነትና ከፍቅር ጋር አብልጦ በዛ።

verses.en: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
verses.fr: C''est une parole certaine et entièrement digne d''être reçue, que Jésus-Christ est venu dans le monde pour sauver les pécheurs, dont je suis le premier.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኞችን ሊያድን ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ወደ ዓለም መጣ የሚለው ቃል የታመነና ሁሉ እንዲቀበሉት የተገባ ነው፤ ከኃጢአተኞችም ዋና እኔ ነኝ፤

verses.en: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.
verses.fr: Mais j''ai obtenu miséricorde, afin que Jésus-Christ fît voir en moi le premier toute sa longanimité, pour que je servisse d''exemple à ceux qui croiraient en lui pour la vie éternelle.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ግን፥ የዘላለምን ሕይወት ለማግኘት በእርሱ ያምኑ ዘንድ ላላቸው ሰዎች ምሳሌ እንድሆን፥ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ዋና በምሆን በእኔ ላይ ትዕግስቱን ሁሉ ያሳይ ዘንድ፥ ምህረትን አገኘሁ።

verses.en: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.fr: Au roi des siècles, immortel, invisible, seul Dieu, soient honneur et gloire, aux siècles des siècles! Amen!
verses.am: ብቻውን አምላክ ለሚሆን ለማይጠፋው ለማይታየውም ለዘመናት ንጉሥ ምስጋናና ክብር እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;
verses.fr: Le commandement que je t''adresse, Timothée, mon enfant, selon les prophéties faites précédemment à ton sujet, c''est que, d''après elles, tu combattes le bon combat,
verses.am: ጢሞቴዎስ ልጄ ሆይ፥ አስቀድሞ ስለ አንተ እንደ ተነገረው ትንቢት፥ በእርሱ መልካም ጦርነት ትዋጋ ዘንድ ይህችን ትእዛዝ አደራ እሰጥሃለሁ፤

verses.en: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:
verses.fr: en gardant la foi et une bonne conscience. Cette conscience, quelques-uns l''ont perdue, et ils ont fait naufrage par rapport à la foi.
verses.am: እምነትና በጎ ሕሊና ይኑርህ፥ አንዳንዶች ሕሊናን ጥለው፥ መርከብ አለ መሪ እንደሚጠፋ፥ በእምነት ነገር ጠፍተዋልና፤

verses.en: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.
verses.fr: De ce nombre sont Hyménée et Alexandre, que j''ai livrés à Satan, afin qu''ils apprennent à ne pas blasphémer.
verses.am: ከእነዚያም፥ እንዳይሳደቡ ይማሩ ዘንድ ለሰይጣን አሳልፌ የሰጠኋቸው፥ ሄሜኔዎስና እስክንድሮስ ናቸው።

verses.en: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
verses.fr: J''exhorte donc, avant toutes choses, à faire des prières, des supplications, des requêtes, des actions de grâces, pour tous les hommes,
verses.am: እንግዲህ እግዚአብሔርን በመምሰልና በጭምትነት ሁሉ ጸጥና ዝግ ብለን እንድንኖር፥

verses.en: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.
verses.fr: pour les rois et pour tous ceux qui sont élevés en dignité, afin que nous menions une vie paisible et tranquille, en toute piété et honnêteté.
verses.am: ልመናና ጸሎት ምልጃም ምስጋናም ስለ ሰዎች ሁሉ ስለ ነገሥታትና ስለ መኳንንትም ሁሉ እንዲደረጉ ከሁሉ በፊት እመክራለሁ።

verses.en: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;
verses.fr: Cela est bon et agréable devant Dieu notre Sauveur,

verses.en: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.
verses.fr: qui veut que tous les hommes soient sauvés et parviennent à la connaissance de la vérité.
verses.am: ሰዎች ሁሉ ሊድኑና እውነቱን ወደ ማወቅ ሊደርሱ በሚወድ በእግዚአብሔር በመድኃኒታችን ፊት መልካምና ደስ የሚያሰኝ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
verses.fr: Car il y a un seul Dieu, et aussi un seul médiateur entre Dieu et les hommes, Jésus-Christ homme,
verses.am: አንድ እግዚአብሔር አለና፥ በእግዚአብሔርና በሰውም መካከል ያለው መካከለኛው ደግሞ አንድ አለ፥ እርሱም ሰው የሆነ ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ነው፤

verses.en: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.
verses.fr: qui s''est donné lui-même en rançon pour tous. C''est là le témoignage rendu en son propre temps,
verses.am: ራሱንም ለሁሉ ቤዛ ሰጠ፥ ይህም በገዛ ዘመኑ ምስክርነቱ ነበረ፤

verses.en: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.
verses.fr: et pour lequel j''ai été établi prédicateur et apôtre, -je dis la vérité, je ne mens pas, -chargé d''instruire les païens dans la foi et la vérité.
verses.am: እኔም ለዚህ ነገር አዋጅ ነጋሪና ሐዋርያ በእምነትና በእውነትም የአሕዛብ አስተማሪ ለመሆን ተሾምሁ፤ እውነት እናገራለሁ፤ አልዋሽም።

verses.en: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
verses.fr: Je veux donc que les hommes prient en tout lieu, en élevant des mains pures, sans colère ni mauvaises pensées.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ወንዶች በስፍራ ሁሉ አለ ቍጣና አለ ክፉ አሳብ የተቀደሱትን እጆች እያነሱ እንዲጸልዩ እፈቅዳለሁ።

verses.en: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;
verses.fr: Je veux aussi que les femmes, vêtues d''une manière décente, avec pudeur et modestie, ne se parent ni de tresses, ni d''or, ni de perles, ni d''habits somptueux,
verses.am: ሴት በነገር ሁሉ እየተገዛች በዝግታ ትማር፤

verses.en: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.
verses.fr: mais qu''elles se parent de bonnes oeuvres, comme il convient à des femmes qui font profession de servir Dieu.
verses.am: ሴት በነገር ሁሉ እየተገዛች በዝግታ ትማር፤

verses.en: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.
verses.fr: Que la femme écoute l''instruction en silence, avec une entière soumission.
verses.am: ሴት ግን በዝግታ ትኑር እንጂ ልታስተምር ወይም በወንድ ላይ ልትሰለጥን አልፈቅድም።

verses.en: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.
verses.fr: Je ne permets pas à la femme d''enseigner, ni de prendre de l''autorité sur l''homme; mais elle doit demeurer dans le silence.
verses.am: አዳም ቀድሞ ተፈጥሮአልና፥ በኋላም ሔዋን ተፈጠረች።

verses.en: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
verses.fr: Car Adam a été formé le premier, Eve ensuite;
verses.am: የተታለለም አዳም አይደለም፥ ሴቲቱ ግን ተታልላ በመተላለፍ ወደቀች፤

verses.en: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.
verses.fr: et ce n''est pas Adam qui a été séduit, c''est la femme qui, séduite, s''est rendue coupable de transgression.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በእምነትና በፍቅር በቅድስናም ራሳቸውን እየገዙ ቢኖሩ በመውለድ ትድናለች።

verses.en: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.
verses.fr: Elle sera néanmoins sauvée en devenant mère, si elle persévère avec modestie dans la foi, dans la charité, et dans la sainteté.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በእምነትና በፍቅር በቅድስናም ራሳቸውን እየገዙ ቢኖሩ በመውለድ ትድናለች።

verses.en: This is a true saying, if a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
verses.fr: Cette parole est certaine: Si quelqu''un aspire à la charge d''évêque, il désire une oeuvre excellente.
verses.am: ማንም ኤጲስ ቆጶስነትን ቢፈልግ መልካምን ሥራ ይመኛል የሚለው ቃል የታመነ ነው።

verses.en: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;
verses.fr: Il faut donc que l''évêque soit irréprochable, mari d''une seule femme, sobre, modéré, réglé dans sa conduite, hospitalier, propre à l''enseignement.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ እንዲህ ሊሆን ይገባዋል፤ የማይነቀፍ፥ የአንዲት ሚስት ባል፥ ልከኛ፥ ራሱን የሚገዛ፥ እንደሚገባው የሚሰራ፥ እንግዳ ተቀባይ፥ ለማስተማር የሚበቃ፥

verses.en: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;
verses.fr: Il faut qu''il ne soit ni adonné au vin, ni violent, mais indulgent, pacifique, désintéressé.
verses.am: የማይሰክር፥ የማይጨቃጨቅ ነገር ግን ገር የሆነ፥ የማይከራከር፥ ገንዘብን የማይወድ፥

verses.en: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;
verses.fr: Il faut qu''il dirige bien sa propre maison, et qu''il tienne ses enfants dans la soumission et dans une parfaite honnêteté;
verses.am: ልጆቹን በጭምትነት ሁሉ እየገዛ የራሱን ቤት በመልካም የሚያስተዳድር፤

verses.en: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)
verses.fr: car si quelqu''un ne sait pas diriger sa propre maison, comment prendra-t-il soin de l''Eglise de Dieu?
verses.am: ሰው ግን የራሱን ቤት እንዲያስተዳድር ባያውቅ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤተ ክርስቲያን እንዴት ይጠብቃታል?

verses.en: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
verses.fr: Il ne faut pas qu''il soit un nouveau converti, de peur qu''enflé d''orgueil il ne tombe sous le jugement du diable.
verses.am: በትዕቢት ተነፍቶ በዲያቢሎስ ፍርድ እንዳይወድቅ፥ አዲስ ክርስቲያን አይሁን።

verses.en: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
verses.fr: Il faut aussi qu''il reçoive un bon témoignage de ceux du dehors, afin de ne pas tomber dans l''opprobre et dans les pièges du diable.
verses.am: በዲያቢሎስ ነቀፋና ወጥመድም እንዳይወድቅ፥ በውጭ ካሉት ሰዎች ደግሞ መልካም ምስክር ሊኖረው ይገባዋል።

verses.en: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
verses.fr: Les diacres aussi doivent être honnêtes, éloignés de la duplicité, des excès du vin, d''un gain sordide,
verses.am: እንዲሁም ዲያቆናት ጭምቶች፥ በሁለት ቃል የማይናገሩ፥ ለብዙ ወይን ጠጅ የማይጎመጁ፥

verses.en: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
verses.fr: conservant le mystère de la foi dans une conscience pure.
verses.am: ነውረኛ ረብ የማይወዱ፥ በንጹሕ ሕሊና የሃይማኖትን ምሥጢር የሚይዙ ሊሆኑ ይገባቸዋል።

verses.en: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.
verses.fr: Qu''on les éprouve d''abord, et qu''ils exercent ensuite leur ministère, s''ils sont sans reproche.
verses.am: እነዚህም ደግሞ አስቀድሞ ይፈተኑ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ያለ ነቀፋ ቢሆኑ በዲቁና ሥራ ያገልግሉ።

verses.en: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.
verses.fr: Les femmes, de même, doivent être honnêtes, non médisantes, sobres, fidèles en toutes choses.
verses.am: እንዲሁም ሴቶች ጭምቶች፥ የማያሙ፥ ልከኞች፥ በነገር ሁሉ የታመኑ ሊሆኑ ይገባቸዋል።

verses.en: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
verses.fr: Les diacres doivent être maris d''une seule femme, et diriger bien leurs enfants et leurs propres maisons;
verses.am: ዲያቆናት ልጆቻቸውንና የራሳቸውን ቤቶች በመልካም እየገዙ እያንዳንዳቸው የአንዲት ሴት ባሎች ይሁኑ።

verses.en: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.fr: car ceux qui remplissent convenablement leur ministère s''acquièrent un rang honorable, et une grande assurance dans la foi en Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: በዲቁና ሥራ በመልካም ያገለገሉ ለራሳቸው ትልቅ ማዕርግና በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ባለው እምነት ብዙ ድፍረት ያገኛሉ።

verses.en: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:
verses.fr: Je t''écris ces choses, avec l''espérance d''aller bientôt vers toi,
verses.am: ፈጥኜ ወደ አንተ እንድመጣ ተስፋ አድርጌ ይህን እጽፍልሃለሁ።

verses.en: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
verses.fr: mais afin que tu saches, si je tarde, comment il faut se conduire dans la maison de Dieu, qui est l''Eglise du Dieu vivant, la colonne et l''appui de la vérité.
verses.am: ብዘገይ ግን፥ በእግዚአብሔር ማደሪያ ቤት መኖር እንዴት እንደሚገባ ታውቅ ዘንድ እጽፍልሃለሁ፤ ቤቱም የእውነት ዓምድና መሠረት፥ የሕያው እግዚአብሔር ቤተ ክርስቲያን ነው።

verses.en: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
verses.fr: Et, sans contredit, le mystère de la piété est grand: celui qui a été manifesté en chair, justifié par l''Esprit, vu des anges, prêché aux Gentils, cru dans le monde, élevé dans la gloire.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርንም የመምሰል ምሥጢር ያለ ጥርጥር ታላቅ ነው፤ በሥጋ የተገለጠ፥ በመንፈስ የጸደቀ፥ ለመላእክት የታየ፥ በአሕዛብ የተሰበከ፥ በዓለም የታመነ፥ በክብር ያረገ።

verses.en: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;
verses.fr: Mais l''Esprit dit expressément que, dans les derniers temps, quelques-uns abandonneront la foi, pour s''attacher à des esprits séducteurs et à des doctrines de démons,
verses.am: መንፈስ ግን በግልጥ። በኋለኞች ዘመናት አንዳንዶች የሚያስቱ መናፍስትንና በውሸተኞች ግብዝነት

verses.en: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;
verses.fr: par l''hypocrisie de faux docteurs portant la marque de la flétrissure dans leur propre conscience,
verses.am: የተሰጠውን የአጋንንትን ትምህርት እያደመጡ፥ ሃይማኖትን ይክዳሉ ይላል፤ በገዛ ሕሊናቸው እንደሚቃጠሉ ደንዝዘው፥

verses.en: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.
verses.fr: prescrivant de ne pas se marier, et de s''abstenir d''aliments que Dieu a créés pour qu''ils soient pris avec actions de grâces par ceux qui sont fidèles et qui ont connu la vérité.
verses.am: እነዚህ ውሸተኞች መጋባትን ይከለክላሉ፥ አምነውም እውነትን የሚያውቁ ከምስጋና ጋር ይቀበሉ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ከፈጠረው መብል እንዲርቁ ያዝዛሉ።

verses.en: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:
verses.fr: Car tout ce que Dieu a créé est bon, et rien ne doit être rejeté, pourvu qu''on le prenne avec actions de grâces,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የፈጠረው ሁሉ መልካም ነውና፥ ከምስጋናም ጋር ቢቀበሉት የሚጣል ምንም የለም፤

verses.en: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
verses.fr: parce que tout est sanctifié par la parole de Dieu et par la prière.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ቃልና በጸሎት የተቀደሰ ነውና።

verses.en: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.
verses.fr: En exposant ces choses aux frères, tu seras un bon ministre de Jésus Christ, nourri des paroles de la foi et de la bonne doctrine que tu as exactement suivie.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ወንድሞችን ብታሳስብ፥ በእምነትና በተከተልኸው በመልካም ትምህርት ቃል የምትመገብ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ መልካም አገልጋይ ትሆናለህ።

verses.en: But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.
verses.fr: Repousse les contes profanes et absurdes. Exerce-toi à la piété;
verses.am: ነገር ግን ለዚህ ዓለም ከሚመችና የአሮጊቶችን ሴቶች ጨዋታ ከሚመስለው ተረት ራቅ። እግዚአብሔርን ለመምሰል ግን ራስህን አስለምድ።

verses.en: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
verses.fr: car l''exercice corporel est utile à peu de chose, tandis que la piété est utile à tout, ayant la promesse de la vie présente et de celle qui est à venir.
verses.am: ሰውነትን ለሥጋዊ ነገር ማስለመድ ለጥቂት ይጠቅማልና፤ እግዚአብሔርን መምሰል ግን የአሁንና የሚመጣው ሕይወት ተስፋ ስላለው፥ ለነገር ሁሉ ይጠቅማል።

verses.en: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.
verses.fr: C''est là une parole certaine et entièrement digne d''être reçue.
verses.am: ይህ ቃል የታመነ ሁሉም እንዲቀበሉት የተገባ ነው፤

verses.en: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.
verses.fr: Nous travaillons, en effet, et nous combattons, parce que nous mettons notre espérance dans le Dieu vivant, qui est le Sauveur de tous les hommes, principalement des croyants.
verses.am: ይህን ለማግኘት እንደክማለንና፥ ስለዚህም እንሰደባለን፤ ይህም ሰውን ሁሉ ይልቁንም የሚያምኑትን በሚያድን በሕያው አምላክ ተስፋ ስለምናደርግ ነው።

verses.en: These things command and teach.
verses.fr: Déclare ces choses, et enseigne-les.
verses.am: እስክመጣ ድረስ ለማንበብና ለመምከር ለማስተማርም ተጠንቀቅ።

verses.en: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
verses.fr: Que personne ne méprise ta jeunesse; mais sois un modèle pour les fidèles, en parole, en conduite, en charité, en foi, en pureté.
verses.am: እስክመጣ ድረስ ለማንበብና ለመምከር ለማስተማርም ተጠንቀቅ።

verses.en: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
verses.fr: Jusqu''à ce que je vienne, applique-toi à la lecture, à l''exhortation, à l''enseignement.
verses.am: በትንቢት ከሽማግሌዎች እጅ መጫን ጋር የተሰጠህን፥ በአንተ ያለውን የጸጋ ስጦታ ቸል አትበል።

verses.en: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
verses.fr: Ne néglige pas le don qui est en toi, et qui t''a été donné par prophétie avec l''imposition des mains de l''assemblée des anciens.
verses.am: ማደግህ በነገር ሁሉ እንዲገለጥ ይህን አስብ፥ ይህንም አዘውትር።

verses.en: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.
verses.fr: Occupe-toi de ces choses, donne-toi tout entier à elles, afin que tes progrès soient évidents pour tous.
verses.am: ለራስህና ለትምህርትህ ተጠንቀቅ፥ በእነዚህም ጽና፤ ይህን ብታደርግ፥ ራስህንም የሚሰሙህንም ታድናለህና።

verses.en: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.
verses.fr: Veille sur toi-même et sur ton enseignement; persévère dans ces choses, car, en agissant ainsi, tu te sauveras toi-même, et tu sauveras ceux qui t''écoutent.
verses.am: ለራስህና ለትምህርትህ ተጠንቀቅ፥ በእነዚህም ጽና፤ ይህን ብታደርግ፥ ራስህንም የሚሰሙህንም ታድናለህና።

verses.en: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;
verses.fr: Ne réprimande pas rudement le vieillard, mais exhorte-le comme un père; exhorte les jeunes gens comme des frères,
verses.am: ሽማግሌ የሆነውን አትገሥጸው፥

verses.en: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
verses.fr: les femmes âgées comme des mères, celles qui sont jeunes comme des soeurs, en toute pureté.
verses.am: እርሱን ግን እንደ አባት፥ ጎበዞችን እንደ ወንድሞች፥ የሸመገሉትን ሴቶች እንደ እናቶች፥ ቆነጃጅቱን እንደ እኅቶች በፍጹም ንጽሕና ለምናቸው።

verses.en: Honour widows that are widows indeed.
verses.fr: Honore les veuves qui sont véritablement veuves.
verses.am: በእውነት ባልቴቶች የሆኑትን ባልቴቶች አክብር።

verses.en: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.
verses.fr: Si une veuve a des enfants ou des petits-enfants, qu''ils apprennent avant tout à exercer la piété envers leur propre famille, et à rendre à leurs parents ce qu''ils ont reçu d''eux; car cela est agréable à Dieu.
verses.am: ማንም ባልቴት ግን ልጆች ወይም የልጅ ልጆች ቢኖሩአት፥ እነርሱ አስቀድመው ለገዛ ቤተ ሰዎቻቸው እግዚአብሔርን መምሰል ያሳዩ ዘንድ፥ ለወላጆቻቸውም ብድራትን ይመልሱላቸው ዘንድ ይማሩ፤ ይህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መልካምና የተወደደ ነውና።

verses.en: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.
verses.fr: Celle qui est véritablement veuve, et qui est demeurée dans l''isolement, met son espérance en Dieu et persévère nuit et jour dans les supplications et les prières.
verses.am: ብቻዋንም ኖራ በእውነት ባልቴት የምትሆን በእግዚአብሔር ተስፋ ታደርጋለች፥ ሌትና ቀንም በልመና በጸሎትም ጸንታ ትኖራለች፤

verses.en: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.
verses.fr: Mais celle qui vit dans les plaisirs est morte, quoique vivante.
verses.am: ቅምጥሊቱ ግን በሕይወትዋ ሳለች የሞተች ናት።

verses.en: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.
verses.fr: Déclare-leur ces choses, afin qu''elles soient irréprochables.
verses.am: ያለ ነቀፋ እንዲሆኑ ይህን ደግሞ እዘዝ።

verses.en: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un n''a pas soin des siens, et principalement de ceux de sa famille, il a renié la foi, et il est pire qu''un infidèle.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ለእርሱ ስለ ሆኑት ይልቁንም ስለ ቤተ ሰዎቹ የማያስብ ማንም ቢሆን፥ ሃይማኖትን የካደ ከማያምንም ሰው ይልቅ የሚከፋ ነው።

verses.en: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man.
verses.fr: Qu''une veuve, pour être inscrite sur le rôle, n''ait pas moins de soixante ans, qu''elle ait été femme d''un seul mari,
verses.am: ባልቴት በመዝገብ ብትጻፍ ዕድሜዋ ከስድሳ ዓመት እንዳያንስ፥ የአንድም ባል ሚስት የነበረች እንድትሆን ያስፈልጋል፤

verses.en: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints' feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.
verses.fr: qu''elle soit recommandable par de bonnes oeuvres, ayant élevé des enfants, exercé l''hospitalité, lavé les pieds des saints, secouru les malheureux, pratiqué toute espèce de bonne oeuvre.
verses.am: ልጆችን በማሳደግ እንግዶችንም በመቀበል፥ የቅዱሳንንም እግሮች በማጠብ፥ የተጨነቁትንም በመርዳት በጎንም ሥራ ሁሉ በመከተል፥ ይህን መልካም ሥራ በማድረግ የተመሰከረላት ልትሆን ይገባል።

verses.en: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;
verses.fr: Mais refuse les jeunes veuves; car, lorsque la volupté les détache du Christ, elles veulent se marier,
verses.am: ባል የሞተባቸውን ቆነጃጅት ግን አትቀበል፤ በክርስቶስ ላይ ተነሥተው ሲቀማጠሉ ሊያገቡ ይወዳሉና፤

verses.en: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.
verses.fr: et se rendent coupables en ce qu''elles violent leur premier engagement.
verses.am: የፊተኛውንም እምነታቸውን ስለ ናቁ ይፈረድባቸዋል፤

verses.en: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
verses.fr: Avec cela, étant oisives, elles apprennent à aller de maison en maison; et non seulement elles sont oisives, mais encore causeuses et intrigantes, disant ce qu''il ne faut pas dire.
verses.am: ከዚህም ጋር ቤት ለቤት እየዞሩ ሥራን መፍታት ደግሞ ይማራሉ፥ የማይገባውንም እየተናገሩ ለፍላፊዎችና በነገር ገቢዎች ይሆናሉ እንጂ፥ ሥራ ፈቶች ብቻ አይደሉም።

verses.en: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.
verses.fr: Je veux donc que les jeunes se marient, qu''elles aient des enfants, qu''elles dirigent leur maison, qu''elles ne donnent à l''adversaire aucune occasion de médire;
verses.am: እንግዲህ ቆነጃጅት ሊያገቡ፥ ልጆችንም ሊወልዱ፥ ቤቶቻቸውንም ሊያስተዳድሩ፥ ተቃዋሚውም የሚሳደብበትን አንድን ምክንያት ስንኳ እንዳይሰጡ እፈቅዳለሁ፤

verses.en: For some are already turned aside after Satan.
verses.fr: car déjà quelques-unes se sont détournées pour suivre Satan.
verses.am: ከአሁን በፊት አንዳንዶች ሰይጣንን እንዲከተሉ ፈቀቅ ብለዋልና።

verses.en: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
verses.fr: Si quelque fidèle, homme ou femme, a des veuves, qu''il les assiste, et que l''Eglise n''en soit point chargée, afin qu''elle puisse assister celles qui sont véritablement veuves.
verses.am: ባልቴቶች ያሉት የሚያምን ቢሆን ወይም የምታምን ብትሆን፥ ይርዱአቸው፥ ቤተ ክርስቲያንም እውነተኞችን ባልቴቶች እንድትረዳ አይክበዱባት።

verses.en: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.
verses.fr: Que les anciens qui dirigent bien soient jugés dignes d''un double honneur, surtout ceux qui travaillent à la prédication et à l''enseignement.
verses.am: በመልካም የሚያስተዳድሩ ሽማግሌዎች፥ ይልቁንም በመስበክና በማስተማር የሚደክሙት፥ እጥፍ ክብር ይገባቸዋል።

verses.en: For the scripture saith, thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.
verses.fr: Car l''Ecriture dit: Tu n''emmuselleras point le boeuf quand il foule le grain. Et l''ouvrier mérite son salaire.
verses.am: መጽሐፍ። የሚያበራየውን በሬ አፉን አትሰር፥ ደግሞ። ለሠራተኛ ደመወዙ ይገባዋል ይላልና።

verses.en: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.
verses.fr: Ne reçois point d''accusation contre un ancien, si ce n''est sur la déposition de deux ou trois témoins.
verses.am: ከሁለት ወይም ከሦስት ምስክር በቀር በሽማግሌ ላይ ክስ አትቀበል።

verses.en: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.
verses.fr: Ceux qui pèchent, reprends-les devant tous, afin que les autres aussi éprouvent de la crainte.
verses.am: ሌሎቹ ደግሞ እንዲፈሩ፥ ኃጢአት የሚሰሩትን በሁሉ ፊት ገሥጻቸው።

verses.en: I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.
verses.fr: Je te conjure devant Dieu, devant Jésus-Christ, et devant les anges élus, d''observer ces choses sans prévention, et de ne rien faire par faveur.
verses.am: አንድን እንኳ በአድልዎ ሳታደርግ፥ እነዚህን ያለ መዘንበል እንድትጠብቅ በእግዚአብሔርና በጌታ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በተመረጡትም መላእክት ፊት እመክርሃለሁ።

verses.en: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.
verses.fr: N''impose les mains à personne avec précipitation, et ne participe pas aux péchés d''autrui; toi-même, conserve-toi pur.
verses.am: በማንም ላይ ፈጥነህ እጆችህን አትጫን፥ በሌሎችም ኃጢአት አትተባበር፤ ራስህን በንጽህና ጠብቅ።

verses.en: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach's sake and thine often infirmities.
verses.fr: Ne continue pas à ne boire que de l''eau; mais fais usage d''un peu de vin, à cause de ton estomac et de tes fréquentes indispositions.
verses.am: ስለ ሆድህና ስለ በሽታህ ብዛት ጥቂት የወይን ጠጅ ጠጣ እንጂ፥ ወደ ፊት ውኃ ብቻ አትጠጣ።

verses.en: Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.
verses.fr: Les péchés de certains hommes sont manifestes, même avant qu''on les juge, tandis que chez d''autres, ils ne se découvrent que dans la suite.
verses.am: የአንዳንዶች ሰዎች ኃጢአት የተገለጠ ነው ፍርድንም ያመለክታል፥ ሌሎችን ግን ይከተላቸዋል፤

verses.en: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
verses.fr: De même, les bonnes oeuvres sont manifestes, et celles qui ne le sont pas ne peuvent rester cachées.
verses.am: እንዲሁ መልካም ሥራ ደግሞ የተገለጠ ነው፥ ያልተገለጠም ከሆነ ሊሰወር አይችልም።

verses.en: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.
verses.fr: Que tous ceux qui sont sous le joug de la servitude regardent leurs maîtres comme dignes de tout honneur, afin que le nom de Dieu et la doctrine ne soient pas blasphémés.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ስምና ትምህርቱ አንዳይሰደብ፥ ከቀንበር በታች ያሉቱ ባሪያዎች ሁሉ ለገዙአቸው ጌቶች ክብር ሁሉ እንደ ተገባቸው ይቍጠሩአቸው።

verses.en: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.
verses.fr: Et que ceux qui ont des fidèles pour maîtres ne les méprisent pas, sous prétexte qu''ils sont frères; mais qu''ils les servent d''autant mieux que ce sont des fidèles et des bien-aimés qui s''attachent à leur faire du bien. Enseigne ces choses et recommande-les.
verses.am: የሚያምኑም ጌቶች ያሉአቸው፥ ወንድሞች ስለ ሆኑ አይናቁአቸው፥ ነገር ግን በመልካም ሥራቸው የሚጠቅሙ የሚያምኑና የተወደዱ ስለ ሆኑ፥ ከፊት ይልቅ ያገልግሉ።

verses.en: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un enseigne de fausses doctrines, et ne s''attache pas aux saines paroles de notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ et à la doctrine qui est selon la piété,
verses.am: እነዚህን አስተምርና ምከር። ማንም ልዩ ትምህርት የሚያስተምር ከጌታችንም ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በሆነው ጤናማ ቃልና እግዚአብሔርን ለመምሰል በሚስማማ ትምህርት የማይጠጋ ቢሆን፥

verses.en: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,
verses.fr: il est enflé d''orgueil, il ne sait rien, et il a la maladie des questions oiseuses et des disputes de mots, d''où naissent l''envie, les querelles, les calomnies, les mauvais soupçons,

verses.en: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.
verses.fr: les vaines discussions d''hommes corrompus d''entendement, privés de la vérité, et croyant que la piété est une source de gain.
verses.am: በትዕቢት ተነፍቶአል አንዳችም አያውቅም፥ ነገር ግን ምርመራን በቃልም መዋጋትን እንደ በሽተኛ ይናፍቃል፤ ከእነዚህም ቅንዓትና ክርክር ስድብም ክፉ አሳብም እርስ በርስ መናደድም ይወጣሉ፥ አእምሮአቸውም በጠፋባቸው እውነትንም በተቀሙ፥ እግዚአብሔርን መምሰል ማትረፊያ የሚሆን በመሰላቸው ሰዎች ይገኛሉ። እንደነዚህ ካሉት ራቅ።

verses.en: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
verses.fr: C''est, en effet, une grande source de gain que la piété avec le contentement;
verses.am: ኑሮዬ ይበቃኛል ለሚለው ግን እግዚአብሔርን መምሰል እጅግ ማትረፊያ ነው፤

verses.en: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.
verses.fr: car nous n''avons rien apporté dans le monde, et il est évident que nous n''en pouvons rien emporter;
verses.am: ወደ ዓለም ምንም እንኳ አላመጣንምና፥

verses.en: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
verses.fr: si donc nous avons la nourriture et le vêtement, cela nous suffira.
verses.am: አንዳችንም ልንወስድ አይቻለንም፤ ምግብና ልብስ ከኖረን ግን፥ እርሱ ይበቃናል።

verses.en: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.
verses.fr: Mais ceux qui veulent s''enrichir tombent dans la tentation, dans le piège, et dans beaucoup de désirs insensés et pernicieux qui plongent les hommes dans la ruine et la perdition.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን ባለ ጠጎች ሊሆኑ የሚፈልጉ በጥፋትና በመፍረስ ሰዎችን በሚያሰጥምና በሚያሰንፍ በሚጎዳም በብዙ ምኞትና በፈተና በወጥመድም ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
verses.fr: Car l''amour de l''argent est une racine de tous les maux; et quelques-uns, en étant possédés, se sont égarés loin de la foi, et se sont jetés eux-mêmes dans bien des tourments.
verses.am: ገንዘብን መውደድ የክፋት ሁሉ ሥር ነውና፥ አንዳንዶች ይህን ሲመኙ፥ ከሃይማኖት ተሳስተው በብዙ ሥቃይ ራሳቸውን ወጉ።

verses.en: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
verses.fr: Pour toi, homme de Dieu, fuis ces choses, et recherche la justice, la piété, la foi, la charité, la patience, la douceur.
verses.am: አንተ ግን፥ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሆይ፥ ከዚህ ሽሽ፤ ጽድቅንና እግዚአብሔርን መምሰል እምነትንም ፍቅርንም መጽናትንም የዋህነትንም ተከታተል።

verses.en: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
verses.fr: Combats le bon combat de la foi, saisis la vie éternelle, à laquelle tu as été appelé, et pour laquelle tu as fait une belle confession en présence d''un grand nombre de témoins.
verses.am: መልካሙን የእምነት ገድል ተጋደል፥ የተጠራህለትንም በብዙም ምስክሮች ፊት በመልካም መታመን የታመንህለትን የዘላለምን ሕይወት ያዝ።

verses.en: I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;
verses.fr: Je te recommande, devant Dieu qui donne la vie à toutes choses, et devant Jésus-Christ, qui fit une belle confession devant Ponce Pilate,
verses.am: ሁሉን በሕይወት በሚጠብቅ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት፥ በጴንጤናዊውም በጲላጦስ ዘንድ መልካሙን መታመን በመሰከረ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ፊት አዝሃለሁ፤

verses.en: That thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.fr: de garder le commandement, et de vivre sans tache, sans reproche, jusqu''à l''apparition de notre Seigneur Jésus Christ,
verses.am: ጌታችን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እስኪገለጥ ድረስ ያለ እድፍና ያለ ነቀፋ ሆነህ ትእዛዙን ጠብቅ፤

verses.en: Which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;
verses.fr: que manifestera en son temps le bienheureux et seul souverain, le roi des rois, et le Seigneur des seigneurs,
verses.am: ያንም መገለጡን በራሱ ጊዜ ብፁዕና ብቻውን የሆነ ገዥ፥ የነገሥታት ንጉሥና የጌቶች ጌታ፥ ያሳያል።

verses.en: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.
verses.fr: qui seul possède l''immortalité, qui habite une lumière inaccessible, que nul homme n''a vu ni ne peut voir, à qui appartiennent l''honneur et la puissance éternelle. Amen!
verses.am: እርሱ ብቻ የማይሞት ነው፤ ማንም ሊቀርበው በማይችል ብርሃን ይኖራል፤ አንድ ሰው እንኳ አላየውም ሊያይም አይቻለውም፤ ለእርሱ ክብርና የዘላለም ኃይል ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;
verses.fr: Recommande aux riches du présent siècle de ne pas être orgueilleux, et de ne pas mettre leur espérance dans des richesses incertaines, mais de la mettre en Dieu, qui nous donne avec abondance toutes choses pour que nous en jouissions.
verses.am: በአሁኑ ዘመን ባለ ጠጎች የሆኑት የትዕቢትን ነገር እንዳያስቡ፥ ደስም እንዲለን ሁሉን አትርፎ በሚሰጠን በሕያው እግዚአብሔር እንጂ በሚያልፍ ባለ ጠግነት ተስፋ እንዳያደርጉ እዘዛቸው።

verses.en: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;
verses.fr: Recommande-leur de faire du bien, d''être riches en bonnes oeuvres, d''avoir de la libéralité, de la générosité,
verses.am: ጢሞቴዎስ ሆይ፥ በውሸት እውቀት ከተባለ ለዓለም ከሚመች ከከንቱ መለፍለፍና መከራከር እየራቅህ፥ የተሰጠህን አደራ ጠብቅ፤

verses.en: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.
verses.fr: et de s''amasser ainsi pour l''avenir un trésor placé sur un fondement solide, afin de saisir la vie véritable.
verses.am: ጢሞቴዎስ ሆይ፥ በውሸት እውቀት ከተባለ ለዓለም ከሚመች ከከንቱ መለፍለፍና መከራከር እየራቅህ፥ የተሰጠህን አደራ ጠብቅ፤

verses.en: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:
verses.fr: O Timothée, garde le dépôt, en évitant les discours vains et profanes, et les disputes de la fausse science
verses.am: ይህ እውቀት አለን ብለው፥ አንዳንዶች ስለ እምነት ስተዋልና። ጸጋ ከአንተ ጋር ይሁን።

verses.en: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with thee. Amen.
verses.fr: dont font profession quelques-uns, qui se sont ainsi détournés de la foi. Que la grâce soit avec vous!
verses.am: ይህ እውቀት አለን ብለው፥ አንዳንዶች ስለ እምነት ስተዋልና። ጸጋ ከአንተ ጋር ይሁን።
